|strategy=By [mailto:jediknight@decipher.com Justin Pakes, Jedi Knight]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/light/small/corporaldelevar.html</ref>

The good medic Delevar is an mains best friend! Your [[Han Solo{{!}}Han]], [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] and [[Chewbacca]]'s can cause some major damage when they get together, but [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] with his saber (and [[Grand Moff Tarkin{{!}}Tarkin]] to slow your battle destiny drawing down) can put a real downer on your party!

This is where Delevar comes in handy! Sure [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]]'s saber can still hit your character, but you can still sacrifice that character for full forfeit value, meaning that should be enough to cover you for the battle! Thus even with teh saber, you should onlylose one character form the site. Meanwhile, if youhave armed [[Han Solo{{!}}Han]] and [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] (or are using EPPs or [[Chewie (The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game){{!}}Chewie]]'s [[Bowcaster]]!) then your opponent shouldn't be so lucky.

Of course Delevar has to be wary. He is often the firsttarget for those sabers anyhow. But even then he has still done his job, kept your mains alive!

Combo: = even when hit by Vaders saber. sacrifice the EPP chaarcter for full forfeit value...into your Used Pile!
